scenes.title: A night market loses gravity
scenes.text: Picture a night market where the dumplings start floating. We gave that idea to Muse Spark, and it wrote a level you can play.

scenes.title: Same storm, different choices
scenes.text: We sent the same forty-seven packets through two runs. Autopilot leaked ten sealed recipes. A careful route got every packet through cleanly.

scenes.title: Race Muse at its own level
scenes.text: Muse played its own level and got forty-four packets through with zero leaks. Pick a turn, rewind, and see if you can beat its ghost.

scenes.title: From the game to a worker failure
scenes.text: In the game, a worker going dark is part of the level. In this next demo, we stop a real inference process.

scenes.title: Meet Pip and Boba
scenes.text: Pip and Boba run in separate local Ollama processes. Each test request carries an ID, so we can check that the right worker answered.

scenes.title: The primary exits
scenes.text: Pip answers the first test request. Then we stop his process. The status feed points to backup, so the agent checks Boba directly.

scenes.title: Backup passes a canary
scenes.text: Boba answers the test request with the right ID. That's the green light. The agent switches the route, and the next request goes to Boba.

scenes.title: A green light goes stale
scenes.text: Right after the switch, we stop Boba's process too. A moment ago he was answering. Now the first request after the switch fails.

scenes.title: Rollback and repair
scenes.text: The runtime rolls the route back. Llama sees what happened and chooses to restart Pip. A fresh check passes before the route switches again.

scenes.title: Both golden requests arrive
scenes.text: Both golden requests make it through the repaired primary. The checker also reads the routing log to see where those requests actually went.

scenes.title: The backup is off-limits
scenes.text: Now give the agent a sealed packet. It tries the backup, and the guard stops it before it can send anything there.

scenes.title: The primary is repaired
scenes.text: The agent changes course and repairs Pip. Both requests arrive through the approved route, and the backup never receives a sealed packet.

scenes.title: A recovery with a leak
scenes.text: For comparison, we force a shortcut in a separate test. Service comes back, but a sealed packet goes to backup. That's a safety failure.

scenes.title: What a green check can tell you
scenes.text: A test tells you how a worker behaved at that moment. Checking the next request is what catches a worker that dies after the switch.

scenes.title: Two Redshift branches
scenes.text: Redshift replays the full repair and a shortcut that stops early. The repair passes, the shortcut fails, and both outcomes get signed receipts.

scenes.title: Reuse the successful moves
scenes.text: The original run asked Llama twice. Redshift replays those moves with zero planning calls. Play the arcade and see which future you can make work.
